name: Tales of the Wild
source:
Life in the Domains has always felt tame, but a chance encounter will spirit you away to a place few have ever heard of: Tallev, home to animal shifter clans and fantastic creatures. The wild ways of Tallev and its inhabitants will challenge you at every turn, but if you open your heart to the right person, you may spin a tale of discovery and love.

[From in-game description]
translation:
领地里的生活总是让人感觉平淡无奇，但一次偶然的邂逅会让你来到一个很少有人听说过的地方：塔勒夫，动物变形者部落和神奇生物的家园。塔勒夫及其居民的狂野生活方式将处处挑战你，但如果你向正确的人敞开心扉，你可能会编织一个关于发现和爱情的故事。

[摘自游戏内描述]
